description: Session-cache misses surged in production ca-central-1, and session lookups slowed.
issue_summary: At capture, 78% of session-cache lookups missed cache and session lookup latency was 840 ms at p95.
trigger_summary: The 78% miss ratio exceeded this synthetic alert's 60% miss-ratio threshold. The alert also requires elevated backing-store request rate, but that rate was not captured, so its threshold breach cannot be independently verified from this snapshot.
log_summary: No confirmed TTL change or broad invalidation event in the provided snapshot.

splunk_searches.name: session-cache miss messages
splunk_searches.coverage: partial; Redis error and eviction logs were not available

events.message: Session cache miss ratio exceeded the alert threshold.
Session lookup latency increased; cause not established.
